messages:
maria: Cutting RC now: 2026.3.0-rc4. Artifact built and pushed. Target promo window: 2026-04-02 10:00-12:00 PST. Need QA signoff, infra pin, and oncall ack. @sasha @ash @ops-oncall

deploy-bot: artifact redwood-service:2026.3.0-rc4 (sha: a1b2c3d4). Integration tests: ✅. Canary image pushed to staging. CI: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

sasha: QA update: smoke + regression on staging are green. Found a flaky reranker test — filed #3489, not blocking for prod promo.

leila: Note: RC includes optional DB change (add nullable col to user_profile). Migration is online/nullable. Plan: run migration on canary hosts prior to traffic shift, verify no errors. No rollback migration required.

ash: Infra checklist: will pin nodes and disable autoscaler for the reserved pool during the 10:00-12:00 window. Will also hold any node drains 30m post-promo. Capacity looks good for planned throughput.

samir: Rollout plan proposed: 10% canary (15m monitoring) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (60m) if no alerts. Canary cohort: user_id % 10 == 0. Monitoring hooks: latency p50/p95, error-rate, and model-ops metrics.

ops-oncall: Oncall acked. Rollback plan documented: immediate rollback to 2026.2.9 if severe errors. Quick rollback commands (ops):
```
# revert deployment image
kubectl set image deployment/redwood redwood=redwood-service:2026.2.9 -n prod
# run rollback script to toggle traffic and clear caches
/opt/deploy/rollback.sh --from=2026.3.0-rc4 --to=2026.2.9
```
DB note: no revert needed for nullable column.

maria: :thumbsup: Locking promo window. @infra please pin 2026.3.0-rc4 in the release table and add the rollback playbook link.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: pass. Canary manifests validated. Release notes draft: - performance improvements for serving runtime; - minor reranker fix; - nullable db column for user_profile.

ash: Added rollback playbook entry to the release doc: https://wiki.internal/releases/2026.3.0-rc4. Also added a hotspot watch for latency spike fallback (feature flag to revert to model vshort).

sasha: QA will be on standby during the window and will post final green 30m before promo. Current state: QA = green.

maria: Thanks team — locking in RC and creating promo ticket. If anything changes between now and window call an immediate hold.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the first 90m of the rollout. Ping me on #oncall immediately for any abnormalities.

maria: copy. I'll post the promo ticket and add runbook links. Good to go unless objections. :white_check_mark:
